posts.name: Estelindis
posts.cooked:
Wakukee, as I said to you on Reddit (you're Tre2 there, yes?), I adore what you did with the incap side.  Combining art from the comic page with Iron Legacy's "reluctant victory" face from the video game was an amazing idea.  I love, love, love it.

I wanted to print it, but just one thing didn't suit my personal taste: the incap image was styled a bit differently from the front.  For example, it seems to me that the front image uses very little shading/airbrushing, whereas the Iron Legacy face from the video game uses a lot, so it looks like you harmonised the two by putting more shading on the body from the comic.  Also, it's darker than the front.  My taste would be the opposite: I wanted it to be bright and clean, matching the front image.  Also, I preferred not to reverse the image, as it reverses the lantern logo on Legacy's chest, and if one tries to mirror that back the chest lines interfere a bit with the lantern lines.  So I'm redoing the whole thing myself from scratch.  I don't mean any offence by redoing it, as I truly appreciate both your idea and the work you did.  Anyway, since I am redoing it, I thought I might as well ask others for opinions. 

It's still a work in progress.  I am posting now, before it's finished, because I'm not sure which way to have the crossword facing.  I need to decide that before I fill in the words.  (As I suggested earlier - and I was delighted to see you did this - the words will be related to Baron Blade).  Does anyone have an opinion on which direction of crossword looks better? 

![](upload://j8icbcTufZ6Sg40Pgo3T0oZyvUc.jpeg)

 

![](upload://i8AhlBIJEg0KrorznnEfkXlyQno.jpeg)

Anyway, regardless of which direction people think looks better (as people may have differences of opinion about this), if anyone is interested in modifying it further, I can share my Gimp file which other people can use.  People could even make their own cards with different words in them, if they like.  It's layered so that it shouldn't be too hard to change the shape of the grid itself, if people want a different layout (the crossword part is three separate layers: paper, grid, and spaces).  I thought this would be a nice idea, in the spirit of the wonderful joke that the words Legacy puts into the crossword aren't the answers to the clues, just whatever he fills like putting in.  :D

Seeing as some group-buys for Printer Studio versions of this card are happening (and closing soon!), it seems like any changes I'm going to make should be now or never.  Accordingly, I'm trying to make this fit as perfectly as possible with the formatting and style of printed cards.  I notice a few things:

  • Adam is credited as artist on the front of every printed card, not on the back.  The credit is taken as applying to the whole card.
  • Some cards say "One player may draw 1 card now."  Others say "One player may draw a card now."  Not sure what the reasoning behind the different phrasing might be!
  • Incap text on printed cards is a good bit larger than what's currently in the image (looks like font size 40 vs. 32).  I only just noticed the card images as they look physically have bigger text than in the video game.

Does anything else stand out as something that should be tweaked?  Anything that should be applied to both versions of the card (some people prefer different incap powers) will be applied.
